question: Who became the first Chief Minister of Manipur belonging to Bharatiya Janata Party?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nongthombam Biren Singh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nongthombam Biren Singh **became the first Chief Minister of Manipur, belonging to the **Bharatiya Janata Party.**
 
• He is a** former football player and journalist** who joined politics in 2002. 
 
 
• He was a member of the Indian National Congress (INC) before** joining the BJP in 2016. **
 
 
 
• He became the **12th ****Chief Minister of Manipur in March 2017**, after the BJP formed a coalition government with other parties.
 
• He has **represented the Heingang Assembly constituency** in the Manipur Legislative Assembly since 2002.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP):

 
 
• In India, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is a significant political party.
 
• The Bharatiya Jana Sangh, founded in 1951 by Syama Prasad Mookerjee, is where the BJP got its start.
 
• The Jana Sangh combined with a number of other parties to establish the Janata Party following the declaration of a state of emergency in 1977.
 
• In 1980, the Janata Party came to an end after three years in office, and the former Jana Sangh members got back together to form the BJP.
 
• After the 1998 general election, the BJP-led coalition known as the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) formed a government under Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee for a year.
 
• Since 2014, it has been the ruling political party in India under the incumbent Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
 
 
• **Manipur **is a state in **northeastern India** that **borders Myanmar** (formerly **Burma**).
 
 
• It is known for its rich culture, diverse ethnic groups, and natural beauty.
 
• The state has been facing several challenges, such as insurgency, drug trafficking, and ethnic conflicts.
 
 
 
• **Manohar Parrikar **was a prominent BJP leader from Goa who served as the **Chief Minister of Goa from 2000 to 2005** and again from 2012 to 2014.
 
 
• He later **became the Defence Minister of India in 2014** and served in that position until 2017, when he returned to Goa as the Chief Minister.
 
• He **passed **away in **March 2019** due to **pancreatic cancer.**
 
 
 
• **Longjam Thambu Singh** and **Okram Ibobi Singh** are both **former Chief Ministers of Manipur** who **belonged to the INC (Indian National Congress).**
 
 
• Longjam Thambu Singh served as the Chief Minister for a brief period in 1992, while Okram Ibobi Singh was the Chief Minister for three consecutive terms from 2002 to 2017.
